question: Should a bundled OpenClaw skill passed to skills install produce bundled-skill guidance, or should bundled defaults also map to explicitly trusted ClawHub packages?
rationale: ClawHub intentionally cannot choose between publishers, while OpenClaw owns the bundled copies and the caller-facing command; no official registry mapping exists for these names.

options.title: Guide bundled-skill users
options.body: Detect bundled names in OpenClaw, explain that they are already included, and reserve ClawHub installation for owner-qualified references.

options.title: Create trusted mappings
options.body: Define and maintain explicit trusted owner-qualified ClawHub targets for each bundled default name.

recommendation.title: Guide bundled-skill users
recommendation.body: Detect bundled names in OpenClaw, explain that they are already included, and reserve ClawHub installation for owner-qualified references.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work covers both owner-scoped ClawHub resolution and OpenClaw’s owner-qualified install UX.
